store.0: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer from Seattle who is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic. He has been researching drip coffee makers and espresso machines from our company.

Michael is interested in learning more about the espresso machines, specifically the features that would make them suitable for a non-professional barista who wants a café-like experience at home. He is also concerned about the design and aesthetic of the machines, specifically a sleek, modern, stainless-steel finish.
